context: A uni student catches up with his teen friend about life
purpose: Teach: ワケ/さほど/ストック/めぐり/トータル/ボディ/スロー/主として

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 久しぶり！最近どう？大学はワケがわからないくらい課題が多くてさ、もう参ってるよ。
lines.en: Long time no see! How've you been? Uni's piling on assignments like crazy, I'm worn out.
lines.style: Warm reunion opener, casual male university student tone with friendly complaint.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うわー、お疲れ！うちは高校生活、さほど大変じゃないけど、部活が忙しくてさ。
lines.en: Whoa, that sounds rough! High school isn't that bad for me, but club's keeping me busy.
lines.style: Cheerful teen girl response, light sympathy with casual self-report tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: そういえばこの前、近所のジムに入会したんだけど、続けるのスローペースでいいかなって思ってる。
lines.en: Oh by the way, I joined a gym near my place — gonna ease into it at a slow pace.
lines.style: Casual male share, mild self-deprecating tone about lifestyle change.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: えー意外！レンが運動とか珍しいじゃん。ボディ作るぞーって感じ？
lines.en: Whoa, surprising! It's rare for you to work out, Ren. Going for the buff body look?
lines.style: Playful teen teasing tone, light banter with rising intonation feel.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: そんな大層なもんじゃないって。ただ最近、夜中にお菓子のストックを食べ尽くしてて、ヤバいなと。
lines.en: Nothing that ambitious. Just lately I've been polishing off my snack stock at night, which is bad.
lines.style: Self-deprecating confession, conversational rambling male student tone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: あー、わかるー！うちもテスト前になると、トータルで一袋まるごといけちゃう日あるもん。
lines.en: Ah, I get it! Before tests there are days I can polish off a whole bag in total too.
lines.style: Sympathetic teen agreement, animated relatable confession with warmth.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: だよね。あと、季節のめぐりが早すぎて、もう今年も半分終わったって気づいて焦るわ。
lines.en: Right? Also, the seasons fly by — I just realized half the year's gone and it freaks me out.
lines.style: Reflective male musing, casual but slightly wistful conversational beat.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: わかる！うちらの世代、主としてスマホ見て過ごしてるから余計に早く感じるのかもね。
lines.en: Totally! Our generation mostly spends time on phones, so maybe that's why it feels faster.
lines.style: Thoughtful teen reply, light generational observation in casual register.
